Collision enabled, start-only teleport, speed80, arrival radius25 source units; tunnel passage and B-side exit path only, not entire B courtyard.

Collision enabled; no route teleports; speed80; forward arrival25, reverse20 source units. Reverse requires weaving around leaf. Covers B-side threshold approach through portal to CT Mid, not full B courtyard.

Collision enabled, speed80, arrival25; start-only teleport. Full stair route and upper platform recorded separately. Walking telemetry does not establish architectural tread geometry or default-speed timing.

Middle-of-flight collision path repeated both directions at source X320; earlier X380 path near parapet edge preserved. Speed80/arrival25, start-only teleport. Player hull standing Z is not floor or tread evidence.

Collision enabled, no route teleports, speed80, forward arrival20/reverse25. Narrow corridor at source X~180 negative; reverse entrance bends around barrels. Earlier wall/parapet/barrel-blocked plans preserved. Does not validate Mid/Xbox jump or full Top Mid/Suicide footprint.

Collision enabled, speed80, arrival20 through portal/25 on Top Mid path; no route teleports. Portal path weaves east around south leaf tip, then west around opposite tip. Failed straight/westward plans preserved. Separate from Xbox jump.
Collision enabled, speed80, arrival25, start-only teleport. Ground approach from native Top of Mid station to lower Mid. Separate from portal weave and Xbox jump.
Collision enabled, speed80, arrival25, start-only teleport. Southern passage at Y2100 avoids covered crate blocking Y2200; failed first plan preserved. No special boost acceptance.

Collision enabled, speed80, arrival25, start-only teleport. Path uses southern CT arch and Under A ramp at Y2150; joins surveyed Long A street. Walking Z is player hull, not surface. No elevator boost acceptance.

Collision enabled, speed80, arrival25, start-only teleport. Lower stair flight reaches landing at Y1080 before turning west; earlier premature turn blocked on wall. Full rendered count and architectural profile pending.
